body:
Adds `research/partial-participation` (companion to `noisy-local-sgd`): exact stationary noise floor of DiLoCo-style local SGD when each worker joins a round with probability p. Compares participant averaging (E[1/K|K>=1]) with expected-count normalisation (stability limit 2/(sc), contraction floor 1-1/c), shows matched-speed ordering, and derives participation bias with an inverse-propensity fix. 11 tests, simulation-matched within 0.5%. README bullet and site/projects.json entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
